title: Marked flat algebra deformation groupoids and canonical base-change maps
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field] and $B$ a commutative $k$-algebra. Use $\mathrm{Art}_k=\mathcal C_{k,k}$ of [def-sfb-artin-deformation-test-category], with its specified residue augmentation $A\to k$. For $A\in\mathrm{Art}_k$, define $\mathrm{Def}_B(A)$ to have objects factorizations $A\to Q\xrightarrow{p}B$ of $A\to k\to B$, where $Q$ is flat over $A$ [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], $p$ is surjective, and $\ker p=\mathfrak m_AQ$. Thus $p$ specifies the $k$-algebra isomorphism $Q/\mathfrak m_AQ\cong B$. Arrows are $A$-algebra isomorphisms commuting with $p$. Write $J_Q=p^{-1}(J)$ for an ideal $J\subseteq B$. A marked map above $f:A\to A_1$ is a $k$-algebra map $i:Q\to Q_1$ commuting with the coefficient maps and with the markings. It is a base-change map if the canonical tensor comparison $Q\otimes_A A_1\to Q_1$, $q\otimes a_1\mapsto i(q)a_1$, is an isomorphism, using [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product]. For commutative rings $R,S$, ideals $I\subseteq R$, $K\subseteq S$, and $h:R\to S$, say that $g:\widehat R_I\to\widehat S_K$ is its completion map [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion] if, for every $n\ge0$, $x\in\widehat R_I$ and $r\in R$ with $x_n=r\bmod I^n$, one has $(g(x))_n=h(r)\bmod K^n$. This fixes the canonical map at every quotient.
